source: RS12: a planning lane writes a contract in the repository file format and commits it on its branch

turns.command: mkdir -p plans; printf '%s\n' '+++' 'kind = "contract"' 'id = "retry-budget"' 'title = "Add a retry budget"' '' '[[criteria]]' 'id = "c1"' 'text = "A call retries twice."' '' '[[work_orders]]' 'id = "retry-budget-work"' 'title = "Add the budget"' 'repo = "."' 'priority = 2' 'size = "small"' '+++' '' 'Retry a failed call twice.' > plans/retry-budget.md; printf '%s\n' '+++' 'kind = "contract"' 'id = broken' '+++' > plans/broken.md; git add plans; git -c user.name=planner -c user.email=planner@example.com commit -q -m 'plan the retry budget'
